<p align="center"><strong>October 31. Briar House has opened its door again.</strong></p>


<p align="center">You were following the last trick-or-treaters when their costumes vanished between the trees. Only their paper candy bags remained. Ahead, a house stands on a plot that was empty yesterday.</p>

<p align="center">Something knocks from inside the front door. Twelve times. A pale caretaker opens it before the thirteenth. &quot;Come in before she counts you,&quot; he whispers. Behind you, the gate locks.</p>

<p align="center">Every jack-o'-lantern turns toward the sound of your breathing. One mouths your name. You have not told anyone here your name.</p>

<p align="center">A Halloween horror adventure in two chapters, with seven puzzles and six endings. Choose the stone buttons to explore. There is no real-time countdown; wrong answers allow retries, and bookmarking a page saves your place.</p>
